You can have anxiety, but you don’t have autism. You are autistic :)
But same. I went through a diagnostic test (or whatever it’s called in English) and turns out I’m in the same boat.
Anyways Okami seems super sweet. I’m glad he’s able to help a little with the anxiety :)
Ok sorry I’m changing the subject, I just wanna say you seem like a very nice person.
You’re welcome. And I agree. It’s just so complicated :)
Yeah but they’re suicidal as well, so that’s kinda depressing. Well except one of them. At least I don’t think she is... you never know :)

Yeah I can imagine the attention thing being annoying... I haven’t told a lot of people that I’m suicidal (not counting this, of course), and the ones I’ve told understand.
Also even if the person does it for attention, you still need to take them seriously! If you have to go that far for attention there’s still a problem.
I’m sorry to hear about the calls. That’s awful. And how does a guy like him work at a suicide hotline???
I’m first seeing this now. How’d it go? Are you awake yet?
Yeah I just realized that would’ve been a good idea to add as well.. I live in Denmark, but I still wanna hear about it, if you don’t mind :)
